author: RobertGTA
quote:
1/10 – Fun has been completely removed
This is nothing like GTA V. They sanitized the entire series so hard that the core fantasy is gone. You’re locked into a boyfriend/relationship simulator with Lucia—chores, affection checks, and story beats that kill the chaos. No prostitutes (removed on purpose so the couple stays the focus). Car theft is now a gated system with trackers, tools, and restrictions instead of the free smash-and-drive fun from previous games. Everything runs at a locked 30 FPS with no performance mode. The open-world sandbox that made GTA addictive has been stripped out in favor of a polished but lifeless narrative. Critics gave it 99; players who wanted actual GTA are right to call this a 1.
